Rabbit and bird travel limits

Welcome to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Before you depart, focus on safe handling, clear paperwork, and calm transport for your companion.

First, check the weight standard. A rabbit and its crate together must not exceed 18 kg, meaning the heaviest allowed total for the pet plus the container.

Next, check the age rule. A bird can travel starting at 15 weeks, meaning the youngest age when the animal is cleared for flight.

Pack for comfort, keep documents within easy reach, and plan to arrive early. Handlers use gentle, humane methods, and you will get straightforward steps from a passenger coordinator before the journey begins.

If you get stuck, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways for prompt help.
